summary_1line: Hanuman asks an ascetic about a mysterious golden grove, and the sage explains it was magically built by the demon-architect Maya before Indra slew him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman and the exhausted monkeys stand in a dark cavern suddenly opening into a radiant grove of golden trees, lotus ponds, and jeweled mansions.
The bark-clad ascetic wearing a black antelope skin speaks calmly to Hanuman amid the glowing golden trees inside the cavern.
Indra hurls his thunderbolt from the sky at the demon-architect Maya in a celestial forest.
